units.text: 2 sockets per booth, extension cords bring your own

units.author: Max V.
units.text: Rhea, any update on streaming? Venue needs to know by 5 October

units.author: Rhea
units.text: Our CMO is travelling, I'll push next week

units.author: Max V.
units.text: For transparency: without your add-on we don't stream, our budget doesn't cover it

units.author: Rhea
units.text: Understood

units.author: Oskar
units.text: Can we bring a roll-up banner to Hall B too?

units.author: Max V.
units.text: Only foyer, sorry, hall rules

units.author: Rhea
units.text: Logo files for lanyards attached, SVG and PNG

units.author: Max V.
units.text: Thanks, sent to print

units.author: Max V.
units.text: Rhea, five days left for the streaming decision

units.author: Rhea
units.text: I know, sorry. It's between us and another event budget

units.author: Rhea
units.text: Our 5-minute stage slot — who from your side introduces us?

units.author: Anna
units.text: Я, перед кейноутом второго дня

units.author: Max V.
units.text: Rhea, today is the deadline the venue gave us for streaming

units.author: Rhea
units.text: Still waiting for the CMO, I'll write tonight

units.text: Our team arrives 13 Oct, 3 people for the booth

units.author: Max V.
units.text: Badges will be at the sponsor desk

units.text: Great day 1 and 2, lots of leads. Thanks Max!

units.author: Max V.
units.text: Рад слышать 🙌
